name: Korean peninsula
summary: North Korea's last launch found was on 4 Nov, when it fired several missiles from Sondok; none found since
state: South Korea's Joint Chiefs of Staff said North Korea fired several missiles toward the East Sea from the Sondok area on 4 Nov, its fourth launch event in a week (NK News). North Korea then claimed new missile technology while US–North Korea diplomacy remained in doubt (Stars and Stripes, 5 Nov). Searches on 10 Nov found no later launch, nuclear test or ICBM overflight of Japan, but launches within two weeks keep the signal at Watch.
for_you: There is no change for people in the region. Travellers to South Korea or Japan should check FCDO travel advice and follow local alerts.
rubric_hit: Missile launches within two weeks (4 Nov); no nuclear test, overflight or clash
